request.prompt: Stylised hand-painted game VFX with crisp dark outlines, on a pure black background. A sprite sheet for a video game visual effect: 16 sequential animation frames arranged in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. The effect: a burst of black and violet shadow smoke with golden sparks. Frame 1: a small violet glow at the centre. Frames 2 to 5: dark violet and black smoke erupts upward in curling plumes with a gold-white flash at its heart. Frames 6 to 10: the plumes billow wider, with golden sparks and small glowing golden Egyptian scale symbols swirling in them. Frames 11 to 16: the smoke thins, drifts upward and fades until the last frame is nearly black. Deep violet, black and gold.
